options.name: rules
options.description: Cross-field rules { fields, validate(values), target? }. Run on validate/submit and live on every edit after the first submit. The first failing rule per target wins.

options.name: validate
options.description: (values, signal) => Promise<FormErrors>. Runs on submit after constraints and rules pass. Rejection or timeout reports reason 'async-failed'.

options.name: summaryTitle
options.description: Error summary heading. Default: localized "There is a problem". Applied when the summary is created, on update(), and on global configuration changes.

options.name: summaryHost
options.description: Element that hosts the error summary. Read only when the summary is first created (on the first failed submission); changing it afterwards has no effect. Default: a <div> inserted as the form's first child on the first failed submit (removed on destroy).

options.name: focusOnInvalid
options.description: Where focus moves after a failed submission. Without a summary, focus always goes to the first invalid field.

options.name: errorSummary
options.description: Render an error summary on failed submission. When false, messages that belong to no field are announced assertively.

options.name: submitMode
options.description: 'event': emit aui-submit only. 'native': then call HTMLFormElement.submit() unless aui-submit was prevented (the submitter's name/value is included).

options.name: asyncTimeoutMs
options.description: Async validator timeout in ms (integer 100..120000). On timeout the signal aborts with a TimeoutError.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of the summary heading and form-level messages.

properties.name: controls
properties.description: Registered controls inside the form, in document order (computed on access).

properties.name: state
properties.description: Frozen { dirty, touched, submitting, submitCount, valid }; valid ignores disabled controls.

properties.name: errorSummary
properties.description: The summary, created lazily on the first failed submission; null until then or when errorSummary is false.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Frozen values by name: enabled named controls first, then plain named native elements outside controls. Unchecked checkboxes/radios, buttons, files, and :disabled elements (including disabled-fieldset descendants) are skipped; repeated names become arrays.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Apply rules, show every control's messages and the summary, and return validity. Does not run the async validator or emit events.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: requestSubmit(): runs the full submit pipeline.

methods.name: setErrors
methods.description: Apply external (server) errors by field name, show them, and move focus. Unknown names and disabled controls are listed in the summary as plain text without a link. Replaces earlier external errors; each clears when the user edits the field or on the next submit.

methods.name: clearErrors
methods.description: Clear every rule and external error this form set, and hide the summary.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Abort pending async validation, reset every control and plain native element to its initial value, clear state and the summary, emit aui-reset.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and validate options; summaryTitle and locale are applied to an existing summary, and rules re-run (skipping unrendered targets) if the form was already submitted. Invalid options leave the previous options in place.

methods.name: registerFormControl
methods.description: Standalone export (not a Form method): register a custom control implementing FormControl so any Form containing control.host discovers it. Marks the host with data-aui-control; call the returned function on destroy to unregister.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Abort async validation, remove listeners and subscriptions, destroy the summary (and remove its host if Form created it), and restore the form's original noValidate value.

events.name: aui-submit
events.description: All validation passed. Prevent it to stop a native submission (submitMode 'native').

events.name: aui-invalid
events.description: Submission stopped: constraint or rule errors, async validator errors, or async validator rejection/timeout.

events.name: aui-state-change
events.description: dirty, touched, submitting, submitCount, or valid changed (deduplicated).

events.name: aui-reset
events.description: The form was reset (reset() or a native reset).

contentAreas.name: controls
contentAreas.description: Consumer-owned children: AbsoluteUI controls, Form Field hosts, plain native elements, and buttons.

cssClasses.name: aui-form
cssClasses.description: Added to the <form>: single-column grid with a space-4 gap.

cssClasses.name: aui-form__actions
cssClasses.description: Optional consumer wrapper for buttons: wrapping flex row.
